verdict_reason: Small, well-scoped CSP change with a helpful inline comment and a test asserting both 'self' and the animals-frontend origin appear in form-action; only a minor robustness nit around a bare new URL() at module load.

todos.issue: Module-level new URL(config.get('tradeImportsAnimalsFrontend.baseUrl')).origin throws a raw TypeError: Invalid URL from Node internals if the env var is set to a malformed value, giving no hint that the CSP plugin or the animals-frontend config key is at fault.
todos.fix: Wrap and rethrow: try { animalsFrontendOrigin = new URL(config.get('tradeImportsAnimalsFrontend.baseUrl')).origin } catch (error) { throw new Error(`Invalid tradeImportsAnimalsFrontend.baseUrl: ${error.message}`, { cause: error }) } — or (preferred) change the config declaration in src/config/config.js to format: 'url' so convict rejects the value at boot with a readable message and this call is safe by construction.
